name: Felt and wool
one_line: Stitched felt hills, pom-pom trees and button doors.
look_words: A world sewn from felt and knitted from wool. Soft greens, dusty rose, oat and linen for the land; hills are stuffed cushions with visible seams, trees are pom-poms, clouds are cotton wool, doors are buttons. Every edge is fuzzy and every join has a stitch you can see. Light is soft daylight from a window, with gentle shadows and no shine anywhere. Plum purple and denim blue mark the things to collect and the goal, red yarn is harm, and the player is fox orange. Motion is soft and springy: things flop, bounce and unravel; thread and yarn trail behind. Avoid hard edges, metal, gloss, sharp shadows, dark scenes and bloom.

palette.name: felt and wool
palette.notes: High ambient light keeps everything soft. The orange player and the red yarn are neighbours: make hazards spiky or tangled so shape helps too.

look_wish: fuzzy fabric shading with stitches, tilt-shift blur

upgrade.why: makes the whole world out of cloth: puffed patches, seams, stitches and fuzzy felt, seen as a small thing on a table

music.mood: soft glockenspiel, ukulele and brushed drums

sound_feel: soft pats, a needle pull, muffled bounces, a zip
